title: Nammura Hammira
desc: A wealthy girl decides to teach a man a lesson by pretending to be in love with him. However, things take an ugly turn when the man marries her in a fit of rage.

title: Ganeshana Maduve
desc: Ganesha lives happily in a complex owned by Ramanamurthy. Things take a turn when he falls in love with Adilakshmi, the youngest daughter of Ramanamurthy who sings under the pseudonym Shruti.

title: Bhairathi Ranagal
desc: Bhairathi Ranagal ends up in jail after going against the law. However, when he is released, he strives to fight for the people of his village.

title: The Villain
desc: Ramu sets out to find his estranged brother, Rama, to reunite him with their mother. However, Ramu soon discovers that Rama is a mafia don, which makes it difficult for Ramu to approach his brother.

title: The Devil
desc: Left for dead after a brutal betrayal, a man known as the Devil returns to reclaim his lost power. However, his quest for vengeance takes an unexpected turn when he encounters Meera.
